svg.title: rEach and Teach: validation, enrollment and sign-in
svg.desc: A sequence across four lanes: student, AI agent, rEach and Teach. The agent runs a security validation pass with made-up answers, rEach asks the student for their enrollment details without the agent seeing them, makes a key pair and a fingerprint and receives a signed enrollment stamp, and every later sign-in asks for the student ID, a yes and the password.
svg.text: Until a student enrolls, nothing works. The agent never sees a single detail the student gives.
course server · private to the instructors
